content_sections.heading: About RGCB Project Research Scientist II
content_sections.text: Rajiv Gandhi Centre for Biotechnology (BRIC-RGCB) is an autonomous research institute under the Biotechnology Research and Innovation Council (BRIC), Department of Biotechnology, Government of India, located in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala. The present appointment is purely temporary to work in the ICMR Intramural Centre for Collaborative Research (CCR) on Malaria and Host Factors under the supervision of Dr. Rajesh Chandramohanadas, Scientist F.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must be Indian citizens meeting the following essential qualifications, experience, and age criteria as specified in the recruitment notification: First Class Post Graduate Degree with PhD in the field of Infectious Disease Biology with a background in bio-engineering, bio-physics, or related areas; OR Second Class Post Graduate Degree, with PhD and three years of experience in the field of Infectious Disease Biology, bio-engineering, bio-physics, or related areas. Experience in one or more of the areas related to mammalian and microbial cell culture, omics, or microscopy. Prior experience in handling blood and blood-borne infectious samples. Experience with single-cell assay platforms, mechanobiology, cellular phenotyping, or microscopy. Proficiency with Python and R, and machine learning tools. Good communication, analytical, and management skills. Research publications in reputed peer-reviewed journals. Prior experience in project management and coordination will be a plus. Availability to travel to partnering institutions in the Northeast for field sample collection and research. Candidates must be Below 35 years as on November 1st, 2026. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated emolument of ₹ 67000 + 20% HRA per month. The appointment is purely on a contract basis, initially for a period of one year or till the termination of the project, whichever is earlier, and is extendable based on the performance evaluation of the candidate.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RGCB Project Research Scientist II
content_sections.text: Applications should be submitted online. Candidates currently working in Government firms should send applications through proper channel. If a candidate wishes to apply for different positions, separate application forms should be submitted for each position. Ensure the application is submitted online on or before the last date: 1 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applicants will be shortlisted for the online selection interview based on the eligibility criteria. Selection of suitable candidates will be made based on qualifications and performance in the selection interview.

content_sections.heading: RGCB Project Research Scientist II Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Selection to the position will not entitle the candidate to any future positions at RGCB (permanent or otherwise). As with all project positions at RGCB, the position will be co-terminus with the end of the project. Applications which are not in the prescribed format will summarily be rejected. Only those fulfilling the above criteria need apply.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in RGCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for the post of Project Research Scientist II (Non-medical).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for RGCB Project Research Scientist II?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving completed online applications is 1 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a First Class Post Graduate Degree with PhD in Infectious Disease Biology with a background in bio-engineering, bio-physics, or related areas, or a Second Class Post Graduate Degree with PhD and three years of relevant experience, along with experience in mammalian/microbial cell culture, omics, or microscopy.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for RGCB Project Research Scientist II?
faq.answer: Candidates must be Below 35 years as on November 1st, 2026, with age relaxation applicable as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for RGCB Project Research Scientist II?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive an emolument of ₹ 67000 + 20% HRA per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for RGCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applicants will be shortlisted based on eligibility criteria, and the final selection will be made through an online selection interview based on qualifications and interview performance.

faq.question: Q7. Is the RGCB Project Research Scientist II post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is temporary and contractual, initially for one year or till project termination (extendable based on performance), and co-terminus with the project.

faq.question: Q8. What are the desirable qualifications for this position?
faq.answer: Desirable qualifications include experience in handling blood samples, single-cell assay platforms, mechanobiology, cellular phenotyping, microscopy, Python/R, machine learning tools, research publications, and project management.
